name: PowerVision Trinity, 2024 study days
note: The PowerVision market-chain run of this repo (DA, ID2, ID3, CID, BAL gates + AC/DC redispatch) on its two study days, published into the run viewer. Real price = OMIE's monthly-average day-ahead profile for July/December (Data/OMIE/omie_price.csv); real mix = OMIE per-technology generation; real physical = ENTSO-E actual generation. REE e-sios series and the PowerVision paper facts are not bundled, so those sections show their missing-data notes.
